# 🌙 dream: collapse the `..` segment in the path `saveCode` prints per generated file

- kind  = fix
- owner = `ehmpathy/sql-dao-generator`
- caught = 2026-09-17
- status = ✅ discharged within the same route · fulcrum `F14`

## .how it was discharged
`saveCode.ts` logs `getNormalizedPath(relativeFilePath)`, so the success stdout reads
`provision/schema/sql/views/view_carriage_hydrated.sql`. the write path is untouched — node's fs
already collapsed `..`. the acceptance snapshot holds no `declarations/../` line.

## .the gap, as it stood
13 lines of the contracted success stdout printed `provision/schema/declarations/../sql/views/…`, a
round trip every reader collapsed by hand on every run.

## .the cue that fired
a `/./` repair in the cli's config path, minutes earlier. once a defect class has a name, its second
instance costs less to find.

## .the lesson the defer left
it waited on an expired SSO token, and the one shortcut — a hand-written snapshot of the expected
output — was refused. a snapshot nobody ran asserts a guess as truth forever.
